**q25.**
- Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language) via `cel-go`, in `internal/filter/engine.go`
- The `Engine` compiles a CEL filter string into a parsed AST, then `internal/filter/parser.go` converts the AST into a dialect-agnostic condition IR (`internal/filter/ir.go`), and `internal/filter/render.go` renders that IR into dialect-specific SQL (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL) with parameterized placeholders.

**q26.** Tables affected when DeleteMemo runs:
- `memo_relation` (explicit cleanup in `store/memo.go:142-146`)
- `attachment` (explicit cleanup in `store/memo.go:149-156`)
- `memo` (the row itself, `store/memo.go:158`)
- `memo_share` (via `ON DELETE CASCADE` foreign key in the schema, `LATEST.sql:109`)
- Additionally, at the API layer, comment memos are deleted first (`memo_service.go:567-577`), each triggering the same cascade on their own `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo`, and `memo_share` records.

**q27.**
- Mechanism: `go:embed` — the compiled React frontend is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served as a static file system with SPA fallback middleware.
- Path: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (lines 20-21)

**q28.**
- `s3presign.Runner` — triggered by a `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (plus one initial `RunOnce` at startup), re-signs S3 presigned URLs for attachments (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)

Unused infrastructure note: The `internal/scheduler` package provides a full cron-style job scheduler, but it is **not imported or used** by the server or any command — no code outside its own package references it.

**q29.**
- Interceptor path: `web/src/connect.ts` (the `authInterceptor` at line 156)
- Token kinds: Bearer access tokens (short-lived JWT) and refresh tokens (via HTTP-only cookie, used to obtain new access tokens)
- Backend package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go` — `Authenticator` struct validates access tokens, refresh tokens, and PATs)

**q30.**
- `memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15`)
- `memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20`)
- `memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25`)
- `memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30`)

All converge for delivery at: `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
